parent_objective: design promotion and generalization protocol for the M966 replay-gate-passing direction-target actor-fit candidate
blocked_by: M966 replay/proof gates passed, but no promotion/generalization protocol exists for alpha_1_0
invalidates: promoting alpha_1_0 based only on public proof replay gates
running PPO continuation before generalization and promotion gates are designed

public_gates: M967 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M967 must separate proof, generalization, and promotion gates
M967 must specify holdout discipline before using any private evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use private holdout evidence
do not treat public proof-gate pass as sufficient promotion evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_promotion: whether a public-proof-passing actor-fit candidate can become a new base after generalization checks
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the next gate layer after M966 public replay/proof pass
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: promotion/generalization design only; no training, no PPO, no promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if design collapses proof, generalization, and promotion into one gate
stop if design uses private holdout as an iterative repair signal
stop if design recommends PPO before replay-gate pass is converted into promotion criteria
fallback_plan: if promotion/generalization design is accepted, route to implementation of a no-training candidate comparison gate
if fresh scenario definition is underspecified, route to randomized scenario-distribution design
if holdout policy is ambiguous, route to holdout governance audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M966 finds alpha_1_0 passes M267/M264 preflight, all six public replay surfaces, behavior seeds, and source-diverse diagnostics

hypothesis: The M966 replay-gate-passing alpha_1_0 candidate needs a separate promotion/generalization protocol before it can replace the current public-gate base or be used for PPO continuation.
success_criteria: proof gates are listed separately from generalization gates
fresh randomized scenario distribution is scoped
behavior retention and ablations are included
failure_criteria: design recommends promotion based only on M966 public replay pass
design omits behavior seeds or ablations
design uses private holdout for iterative tuning

commands.name: write_design
commands.command: Write the M966 alpha_1_0 promotion/generalization gate design and route the next implementation.

decision_rule: M967 may only design generalization and promotion gates. It must not update actor parameters, run PPO, change actor inputs, use private holdout evidence, or promote.
next_blocker: direction-target actor-fit alpha_1_0 has passed public replay gates but lacks a promotion/generalization protocol
